name: Indonesia
overview: Scripture reminds believers of God's sovereign blessing on those who bless His people and the ultimate blessing through Christ to all families of the earth, which includes nations like Indonesia (Genesis 12:3). It calls for integrity and fairness in all dealings, reflecting God's delight in justice rather than deceit (Proverbs 11:1). Believers are encouraged to maintain a heart of humility and refrain from judgment of others (Matthew 7:1), trusting in God's righteous judgment, especially as He will defend His people against opposition (Zechariah 12:9). These truths inspire a Christ-centered approach to understanding and praying for Indonesia's place among the nations.
